material_findings: OptiMer moves mixture optimization to post-CPT parameter-space composition and reports 2.1-6.7 points over uniform DataMix in tested Gemma-3-27B combinations, but its own limitations leave DoReMi/RegMix comparison untested.

The observed official OptiMer public surface is one commit containing only LICENSE, README and the search script, with no releases or published study/checkpoint bundle located; current evidence supports reconstruction rather than checksum-level exact winning-trial replay.
The public OptiMer search is unseeded by default and its default trial/proxy/top-K limits differ from the paper protocol.

The current script derives CPT weight parameter names from parent directory names; sibling checkpoint paths can collide and silently tie distinct Optuna weights. This is scoped to the public code/example contract, not retroactively attributed to the paper experiments.
Data Mixing Agent acquisition is pinned to 384 trajectories, 50M proxy models, 27,266 feedbacks and 1996.08 GPU-hours, making amortization a first-class cost axis.
